//go:build js && wasm

package client

import (
 "math"
 "syscall/js"
 "testing"
)

func checkedJSTestFailure(t *testing.T, run func()) {
 t.Helper()
 failed:=false
 func(){
  defer func(){
   if recovered:=recover();recovered!=nil{
    failure,ok:=recovered.(checkedJSFailure)
    if !ok { t.Error("failure retained a foreign panic value");return }
    if failure.Error()!="nextgo: native operation failed" {t.Error("failure was not fixed")}
    failed=true
   }
  }()
  run()
 }()
 if !failed {t.Fatal("expected a fixed native failure")}
}
func checkedJSTestAccessor(target js.Value,key string,get,set js.Value){
 descriptor:=map[string]any{"configurable":true}
 if get.Type()==js.TypeFunction{descriptor["get"]=get}
 if set.Type()==js.TypeFunction{descriptor["set"]=set}
 checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"defineProperty",target,key,checkedJSObject(descriptor))
}

func TestCheckedJSGetAndIndexCatchActualNativeThrowingAccessors(t *testing.T){
 target:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 // Reflect.get called by JavaScript as a zero-argument getter throws a real
 // native TypeError. No eval, Function constructor or Go panic creates it.
 checkedJSTestAccessor(target,"broken",checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined())
 checkedJSTestAccessor(target,"0",checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined())
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSGet(target,"broken")})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSIndex(target,0)})
}
func TestCheckedJSSetCatchesActualSetterThrowAndFalseResult(t *testing.T){
 target:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 // A setter receives one scalar argument; Reflect.get rejects that scalar as
 // its target, producing a native exception at the setter boundary.
 checkedJSTestAccessor(target,"broken",js.Undefined(),checkedJSReflection.get)
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSSet(target,"broken",true)})
 frozen:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"value":1})
 checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"freeze",frozen)
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSSet(frozen,"value",2)})
}
func TestCheckedJSLengthCatchesGetterAndRejectsInvalidNumericLength(t *testing.T){
 throwing:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 checkedJSTestAccessor(throwing,"length",checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined())
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSLength(throwing)})
 for _,value:=range []any{-1,1.5,math.NaN(),math.Inf(1),float64(9007199254740992),"4"}{
  target:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"length":value})
  checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSLength(target)})
 }
 if got:=checkedJSLength(checkedJSArray([]any{1,2,3}));got!=3{t.Fatal("valid array length changed")}
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSIndex(throwing,-1)})
}
func TestCheckedJSCallNeverRereadsMethodGetterOnBodyFailure(t *testing.T){
 target:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 reads:=0
 getter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{reads++;return checkedJSReflection.get})
 defer getter.Release()
 checkedJSTestAccessor(target,"method",getter.Value,js.Undefined())
 // The getter returns Reflect.get once. Invoking that function without args
 // throws; no failure path may read target.method a second time.
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSCall(target,"method")})
 if reads!=1{t.Fatal("method getter was repeated on failure")}
 broken:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 checkedJSTestAccessor(broken,"method",checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined())
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSCall(broken,"method")})
}
func TestCheckedJSCallPreservesReceiverAndReentrantGetter(t *testing.T){
 target:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"marker":"receiver"})
 method:=js.FuncOf(func(this js.Value,_ []js.Value)any{return checkedJSGet(this,"marker")})
 defer method.Release()
 checkedJSSet(target,"method",method)
 if got:=checkedJSCall(target,"method");got.Type()!=js.TypeString||got.String()!="receiver"{t.Fatal("method receiver changed")}
 reads:=0
 getter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{reads++;return 17})
 defer getter.Release()
 checkedJSTestAccessor(target,"reentrant",getter.Value,js.Undefined())
 if checkedJSGet(target,"reentrant").Int()!=17||reads!=1{t.Fatal("getter reentry changed")}
}
func TestCheckedJSInvokeAndConstructUseCapturedNativeApply(t *testing.T){
 parse:=checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"parseInt")
 if got:=checkedJSInvoke(parse,"15",10);got.Type()!=js.TypeNumber||got.Int()!=15{t.Fatal("primitive invoke changed")}
 date:=checkedJSNew(checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"Date"),123)
 if checkedJSCall(date,"getTime").Float()!=123{t.Fatal("constructor arguments changed")}
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSReflection.get)})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSNew(checkedJSReflection.get)})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSNew(checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"URL"),"http://[")})
}
func TestCheckedJSFailureNeverInspectsPoisonedErrorMessage(t *testing.T){
 poisoned:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 checkedJSTestAccessor(poisoned,"message",checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined())
 // This is a direct representation test of the Go js.Error value produced by
 // Invoke, not a claim that Go callbacks can throw arbitrary JavaScript values.
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){
  func(){defer checkedJSRecover();panic(js.Error{Value:poisoned})}()
 })
}
func TestCheckedJSArgumentsRejectImplicitCompositeConversion(t *testing.T){
 target:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 called:=false
 fn:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{called=true;return nil})
 defer fn.Release()
 checkedJSSet(target,"method",fn)
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSCall(target,"method",map[string]any{"hidden":1})})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSSet(target,"hidden",[]any{1})})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSArray([]any{map[string]any{"nested":1}})})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"nested":[]any{1}})})
 if called{t.Fatal("method ran after argument refusal")}
}
func TestCheckedJSBuildersRequireExplicitNestedValues(t *testing.T){
 child:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"value":"child"})
 list:=checkedJSArray([]any{child,nil,true,7})
 outer:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"list":list})
 if checkedJSLength(checkedJSGet(outer,"list"))!=4{t.Fatal("explicit array changed")}
 if got:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSIndex(list,0),"value");got.Type()!=js.TypeString||got.String()!="child"{t.Fatal("explicit object changed")}
}
func TestCheckedJSInheritedSetterFailurePreservesEarlierMutation(t *testing.T){
 prototype:=checkedJSObject(nil)
 checkedJSTestAccessor(prototype,"blocked",js.Undefined(),checkedJSReflection.get)
 target:=checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"create",prototype)
 checkedJSSet(target,"accepted",11)
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSSet(target,"blocked",true)})
 if checkedJSGet(target,"accepted").Int()!=11{t.Fatal("helper invented rollback of earlier mutation")}
 // The isolated target prototype is deliberately hostile. No global built-in
 // prototype is modified, and the helper promises no rollback or sandbox.
}

func TestCheckedJSApplyUsesPrebuiltArgumentsAndExactReceiver(t *testing.T){
 receiver:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"marker":"prebuilt"})
 called:=0
 method:=js.FuncOf(func(this js.Value,args []js.Value)any{
  called++
  if !this.Equal(receiver)||len(args)!=2||args[0].Type()!=js.TypeString||args[0].String()!="argument"||args[1].Int()!=9 {t.Error("prebuilt receiver/arguments changed")}
  return checkedJSGet(this,"marker")
 })
 defer method.Release()
 // A prebuilt dispatch must not look up a method on the function itself.
 checkedJSTestAccessor(method.Value,"call",checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined())
 arguments:=checkedJSArray([]any{"argument",9})
 // Real integration callers perform their final authority fence here. This
 // test verifies prebuilt argument/receiver behavior, not that caller policy.
 result:=checkedJSApply(method.Value,receiver,arguments)
 if result.Type()!=js.TypeString||result.String()!="prebuilt"||called!=1{t.Fatal("prebuilt apply changed")}
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSApply(checkedJSReflection.get,js.Undefined(),checkedJSArray(nil))})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSApply(js.Undefined(),receiver,arguments)})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSApply(method.Value,receiver,js.Null())})
}
func TestCheckedJSConstructUsesPrebuiltArguments(t *testing.T){
 constructor:=checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"Date")
 arguments:=checkedJSArray([]any{321})
 value:=checkedJSConstruct(constructor,arguments)
 if checkedJSCall(value,"getTime").Float()!=321{t.Fatal("prebuilt construction changed")}
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSConstruct(checkedJSReflection.get,arguments)})
 checkedJSTestFailure(t,func(){checkedJSConstruct(constructor,js.Null())})
}

// Install only a named non-shim key or an Array index above every fixed Invoke
// transport arity used here. Cleanup uses pre-captured native functions with
// primitive/js.Value arguments, not a builder under the poisoned prototype.
func checkedJSTestPrototypeSetter(t *testing.T,prototype js.Value,key string,setter js.Value){
 t.Helper()
 original:=checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"getOwnPropertyDescriptor",prototype,key)
 // A saved accessor descriptor must not inherit the temporarily poisoned
 // descriptor fields when it is restored.
 if original.Type()==js.TypeObject{checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"setPrototypeOf",original,js.Null())}
 remove:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"Reflect"),"deleteProperty")
 define:=checkedJSReflection.defineProperty
 descriptor:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"set":setter,"configurable":true})
 t.Cleanup(func(){
  failed:=false
  func(){
   defer func(){if recover()!=nil{failed=true}}()
   var result js.Value
   if original.Type()==js.TypeUndefined{result=remove.Invoke(prototype,key)}else{result=define.Invoke(prototype,key,original)}
   if result.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean||!result.Bool(){failed=true}
  }()
  if failed{t.Error("prototype fixture restoration failed")}
 })
 result:=define.Invoke(prototype,key,descriptor)
 if result.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean||!result.Bool(){t.Fatal("prototype fixture installation refused")}
}
func checkedJSTestOwnData(t *testing.T,target js.Value,key string,expected js.Value){
 t.Helper()
 descriptor:=checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"getOwnPropertyDescriptor",target,key)
 if descriptor.Type()!=js.TypeObject{t.Fatal("builder did not define an own property")}
 if checkedJSGet(descriptor,"get").Type()!=js.TypeUndefined||checkedJSGet(descriptor,"set").Type()!=js.TypeUndefined{t.Fatal("builder installed an accessor")}
 if !checkedJSGet(descriptor,"value").Equal(expected){t.Fatal("own data value changed")}
 for _,field:=range []string{"writable","enumerable","configurable"}{
  value:=checkedJSGet(descriptor,field)
  if value.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean||!value.Bool(){t.Fatal("own data flags changed")}
 }
}
func TestCheckedJSObjectBuilderBypassesAbsorbingInheritedSetter(t *testing.T){
 const key="__nextgoInteropBuilderAbsorbProbe"
 prototype:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSReflection.object,"prototype")
 sets:=0
 setter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{sets++;return nil})
 t.Cleanup(setter.Release)
 checkedJSTestPrototypeSetter(t,prototype,key,setter.Value)
 object:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{key:41})
 if sets!=0{t.Fatal("object builder invoked an inherited setter")}
 checkedJSTestOwnData(t,object,key,js.ValueOf(41))
 // Set deliberately keeps ordinary write semantics on a separate receiver.
 ordinary:=checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"create",prototype)
 checkedJSSet(ordinary,key,42)
 if sets!=1{t.Fatal("checkedJSSet stopped using inherited write semantics")}
}
func TestCheckedJSObjectBuilderBypassesSetterInstallingGetter(t *testing.T){
 const key="__nextgoInteropBuilderGetterProbe"
 prototype:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSReflection.object,"prototype")
 sets,gets:=0,0
 getter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{gets++;return 99})
 t.Cleanup(getter.Release)
 setter:=js.FuncOf(func(this js.Value,_ []js.Value)any{
  sets++
  checkedJSTestAccessor(this,key,getter.Value,js.Undefined())
  return nil
 })
 t.Cleanup(setter.Release)
 checkedJSTestPrototypeSetter(t,prototype,key,setter.Value)
 object:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{key:43})
 if sets!=0||gets!=0{t.Fatal("builder used authored prototype behavior")}
 checkedJSTestOwnData(t,object,key,js.ValueOf(43))
}
func TestCheckedJSArrayBuilderBypassesHighInheritedSetter(t *testing.T){
 const key="16" // Above the fixed maximum3 Invoke arguments in these helpers.
 prototype:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSReflection.array,"prototype")
 sets,gets:=0,0
 getter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{gets++;return 99})
 t.Cleanup(getter.Release)
 setter:=js.FuncOf(func(this js.Value,_ []js.Value)any{
  sets++
  checkedJSTestAccessor(this,key,getter.Value,js.Undefined())
  return nil
 })
 t.Cleanup(setter.Release)
 checkedJSTestPrototypeSetter(t,prototype,key,setter.Value)
 values:=make([]any,17)
 for i:=range values{values[i]=i}
 array:=checkedJSArray(values)
 if sets!=0||gets!=0{t.Fatal("array builder invoked an inherited setter")}
 checkedJSTestOwnData(t,array,key,js.ValueOf(16))
}
func TestCheckedJSObjectBuilderDefinesProtoKeyAsOwnData(t *testing.T){
 marker:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"marker":"data"})
 object:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"__proto__":marker})
 checkedJSTestOwnData(t,object,"__proto__",marker)
 prototype:=checkedJSCall(checkedJSReflection.object,"getPrototypeOf",object)
 if !prototype.Equal(checkedJSGet(checkedJSReflection.object,"prototype")){t.Fatal("builder changed the target prototype")}
}
func TestCheckedJSDescriptorBootstrapDoesNotUseInheritedValueSetter(t *testing.T){
 prototype:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSReflection.object,"prototype")
 sets:=0
 setter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{sets++;return nil})
 t.Cleanup(setter.Release)
 // This named key is not used by wasm_exec's fixed transport argument array.
 // It detects a descriptor accidentally built as an ordinary inherited object.
 checkedJSTestPrototypeSetter(t,prototype,"value",setter.Value)
 object:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"entry":47})
 array:=checkedJSArray([]any{48})
 if sets!=0{t.Fatal("descriptor construction consulted an inherited setter")}
 checkedJSTestOwnData(t,object,"entry",js.ValueOf(47))
 checkedJSTestOwnData(t,array,"0",js.ValueOf(48))
}
